MLI.note: Document states nothing on a business register; the commercial register is only a bidder's paperwork.

facts.fact: EUMC's call for expressions of interest of 5 June 2025 seeks a consultant to build a module syncing the JIGITUGU attendance and performance solution with the ministry's education portal (API or webhook).
The document says the education ministry has committed to setting up and operationalising a SIGE, and EUMC is recruiting a consultant to strengthen it for integrating JIGITUGU.

MLI.note: Frequent power cuts are mentioned only as a condition for equipment, with no count.
Backup and recovery appear only as training topics and tender deliverables, no site in service or named place.
No figure for schools with internet and no curriculum statement.
JIGITUGU for real-time attendance and performance is being integrated, but the document gives no levels, pilot or live status, or schools using it.
Document is about education, nothing on social programmes.
